surfaces_and_shadows.strategy: Grid Borders (The Technical Look) - No soft shadows. 1px solid borders.

layout.spacing_scale: Tailwind standard, but prioritize p-6 and p-8 for inner card padding.
layout.grid_strategy: MODE B: THE CONTROL ROOM GRID (Dense, Data Correlation). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-4 or gap-6.
layout.alignment: Optical alignment, left-aligned data tables, tabular-nums for metrics.

components_strategy.buttons: Sharp corners, flat colors. Primary: bg-[#00E5FF] text-black hover:bg-[#66EDFF] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide. Secondary: border border-white/20 bg-transparent hover:border-white/50 text-white.
components_strategy.tables: Dense rows, border-b border-white/5, hover:bg-white/5. Tabular numbers for all times/power metrics.
components_strategy.map: Leaflet MUST use 'CartoDB Dark Matter' tiles to blend with the dark tactical theme. (url: 'https://{s}.basemaps.cartocdn.com/dark_all/{z}/{x}/{y}{r}.png'). Segment paths should be #00E5FF (Cyan) and Ride paths #FF3B30 (Blaze) with opacity.
components_strategy.charts: Recharts. Area charts for elevation. Fill gradient from #00E5FF (opacity 0.3) to transparent. Stroke #00E5FF.
components_strategy.file_upload: Dashed border (border-white/20) area, p-12, hover:border-[#00E5FF] hover:bg-[#00E5FF]/5 transition-all.

animations.micro: Hover states scale-up slightly on icon, border color shifts. Fast transitions (duration-150 ease-out).

hero_background.description: Abstract blue topographic map with glowing lines
hero_background.usage: Use as a fixed, low-opacity (10-15%) background texture for the entire app or behind the hero/auth area if any.

empty_state_image.description: Cyclist in the dark riding fast
empty_state_image.usage: Use for 'No Rides Uploaded' or empty dashboard states. Overlay with black gradient.

icons.style: Technical, 1.5px stroke, always pair with text labels in navigation.

testing.data_testid_requirement: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a React frontend with Tailwind CSS.
Install and use 'Barlow Condensed' (Google Fonts) for headings/numbers and 'Manrope' for body.
Setup Leaflet map strictly with CartoDB Dark Matter tiles so it doesn't break the dark theme.
For Shadcn components, override the rounded corners to be rounded-sm or rounded-none and enforce the 1px subtle border aesthetic.
Use Phosphor or Lucide icons for data labels (power, HR, speed, elevation).
Ensure GPX/FIT uploads have a very distinct dropzone area following the tactical theme.
Implement the 'Control Room Grid' spacing: highly dense data cards but clear typography scale.
No gradients on buttons or text. Use solid high-impact colors (#00E5FF).
Include empty states using the provided 'empty_state_image' with heavy dark overlays to maintain the elite vibe.
